shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Soft elevated highlight on interactive cards

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main focal call-to-action button for conversions and admin triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #38bdf8; color: #0f172a; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0284c7; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Article Card
components.description: Editorial destination teaser card with hover lift and glowing border.
components.html:
The Spiritual Path of Cordoba

An inspiring weekend guide exploring centuries of Andalusian architecture, peaceful prayer spaces, and halal gastronomy.
components.css: .ds-card-article { background: #1e293b; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; color: #f8fafc; transition: all 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-article:hover { border-color: #38bdf8; transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1); } .ds-card-article h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #f8fafc; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-article p { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #94a3b8; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: The TUYBA visual interface is an immersive, high-contrast digital sanctuary designed for contemplation, travel discovery, and long-form editorial immersion.
keyCharacteristics: Atmospheric Depth: Deep slate surfaces with subtle ambient elevation and backdrop blur.
Typographic Poise: Fluid responsive headlines with restrained line length for long-form comfort.
Intentional Restraint: Vibrant sky-teal accents used strictly for high-value interactions.
Tactile Modularity: Clear block borders, interactive cards, and responsive disclosure accordions.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Dawn Sky Teal is used on ≤ 10% of any visible viewport.

rules.name: The Editorial Breathing Rule
rules.body: Body paragraphs never exceed 68 characters per line.

dos: Do maintain a strict 68ch reading measure on long-form articles.
Do ensure all text maintains WCAG AA contrast (≥ 4.5:1 against slate backgrounds).
Do provide smooth transitions (0.2s ease) on interactive hover targets.
donts: Don't flood pages with bright primary blue; reserve it for purposeful calls-to-action.
Don't use pure black (#000000) for surfaces; use Midnight Slate (#0f172a).
Don't allow unknown blocks to crash the page; render fallback placeholders.
